comments.author: @willoweable
comments.text: I'm one of those very few people and yes I understand that gambling as a whole is very very terrible. But I am one of the few people who defends the concept of being allowed to gamble because I believe that so long as you can win or you know that you have a good chance of winning, making a bet and winning off of that bet isn't necessarily a bad thing as long as you're smart about it. The problem is that the vast vast vast majority of people do not know how to control themselves with their money. I just don't like when people attack gambling as a whole because I don't like the idea of people having to roll dice in a back alley and possibly getting stabbed because they have to avoid the police because gambling is so looked down upon. I prefer people being allowed to make bets and if I want to bet a couple maybe five bucks guy rolls a dice I lose I go oh well and then I move on with my day I think that shouldn't be a problem. The addicts are the people who really need help and they especially need somebody to interfere. I am also lucky so maybe call it bias
